reviews.author: Hope
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Anthony. He came out the same day I called to look at my car, gave me a very fair price, and came back the next day exactly as promised to do the job. He was friendly, knowledgeable, and professional. It’s hard to find someone reliable and honest, and he definitely was both. He also took the time to talk with my son about helping him get his car back on the road, which I really appreciated. I highly recommend him and will definitely call him again in the future.

reviews.author: Richard Narvaez
reviews.text: I brought my Jeep in with an oil leak coming from the oil filter housing. The mechanic diagnosed the issue quickly and had it completely repaired the same day. Highly recommend for efficient, honest service.

reviews.author: Zeita Ledbetter
reviews.text: I've had my Jeep (Bossi) for over 7 years and have always kept her well-maintained at Lilliston. Getting a second quote AMH & SON Auto repair, I found that none of the work initially quoted was actually needed, Saving me over 2k in repairs. Anthony explained in detail and kept me informed throughout the process, sharing before pictures and videos. The customer service was great, honest, trusting, and transparent. I appreciate his honesty and will definitely return if I need more work done. I recommend giving them a call, you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: For the 1st time in the past 2 years, since I first obtained my truck, I've found a mechanic who cares & took their time to closely examine & feel out my vehicle. Anthony, thank you for taking care of my girl for me by attending to the repairs she needed. My Ford F-250 is running smoothly thanks to you. Best, Michael Mills

reviews.author: Warren Wright
reviews.text: I used AMH & Son Auto Repairs for the first time this year and let him work on my other car too. I gave him a very challenging job. I had a car that had been sitting for 2 years and had multiple issues going on. He accepted the job without hesitation. He took his time and made up a list of what was wrong. There were other things that I had questions about, and he said they looked good and did not try to write up a bill just to make money. He was able to fix the car and it is running great now and it is a very reliable car. I would highly recommend Anthony to anyone looking for a mechanic. He takes credit cards too.

reviews.author: Kelsey Kitzmiller
reviews.text: AMH & SON were able to get our car in immediately and reattach our bumper within hours. They were great, very professional and gave some helpful advice for future fixes. Pricing was great. They also washed off debris from the accident which could have caused further damage, which was much appreciated! Will definitely be going here for future repairs & recommend them to people I know.

reviews.author: Annell C
reviews.text: Anthony replaced my brakes and rotors while ensuring I wouldn’t need to purchase another set of calipers because he was carefully remove the brake pins even though they were rusted. Fair pricing and he finished within a few hours.

reviews.author: chris morales
reviews.text: Anthony is the man he found the issue I been having with my exhaust within a couple of hours and got it replaced asap due to his great timing and good pricing took another truck to him the following week he found the issue and got it fixed again asap , another shop in Bridgeton had my truck and were 2 weeks going towards 3 weeks and couldn't find the problem Anthony got it fixed within a couple days great customer service good timing on working on the cars and good pricing will definitely be recommending anthonys shop and he for sure has our business for next time. It's hard now a days to find a good mechanic with good timing and pricing Anthony is the man thou

reviews.author: Lumarie Jimenez
reviews.text: I had my truck towed there bc it wouldn’t start, only for the owner to tell me that he (the only mechanic there) would be going out for a week and tomorrow would be his last day. That’s pretty important in my opinion- you could have your car back tomorrow or a week from today. His estimate was $1600. Good Year estimated $700. I would not recommend this place.

reviews.author: Donna Bonner
reviews.text: Anthony worked on my daughter car and takes his time to make sure everything is working like it should. He is very polite and fair. I would recommend him as well. I was very satisfied with his work.

reviews.author: Charles Armstrong
reviews.text: Anthony was really good and super fast. Unbeatable price. I'll be getting all my work done here. I'm already bringing my other vehicle in tomorrow. Solid dude with solid work.

reviews.author: William Quevedo
reviews.text: I came here earlier today, near closing time and Anthony was able to squeeze me in. Very understanding guy, not the type of person to shut the door on you. Super chill to talk to and overall good vibes. The process was very quick and smooth. 10/10 recommend to everyone.

reviews.author: ashley colon
reviews.text: Anthony was very professional, he had great communication. I had a couple of issues with me car & He got my car up & running in a fashionable timing. very helpful & affordable. thanks again. definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Damary Munoz
reviews.text: My car broke down on Tuesday and by Thursday it was on the road again thanks to AMH&Son! Who came out to diagnose my car then fixed it. My car drives smooth and his prices are very reasonable. Definitely recommend him , check him out you won’t regret it!

reviews.author: Rut Rodriguez
reviews.text: Super professional and reliable ! Fixed my alternator in less than 2 hours. Super happy with the service we received.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Russell
reviews.text: In from out of town and had a freak out about a noise my car was making - the owner had a fast response, was so helpful and generous, and made my stress leave almost immediately because I knew I could trust him to help me out! The service was fabulous. I would recommend this place to anyone in need of a car repair!

reviews.author: Kiana Gould
reviews.text: Excellent, professional service from Anthony. Had my breaks done, in and out very quickly within an hour. Prices are reasonable. Will be going here again for shocks.

reviews.author: Desmond Jones
reviews.text: I finally found a mechanic that is honest and trustworthy I have and 07 Toyota Avalon took my car there and was very happy with the customer service along with the work that was done no need to go nowhere else great job great guy!

reviews.author: ROCKN42 Rockn42
reviews.text: I took my jeep there thinking I had a fuel issue but Anthony carefully diagnosed my problem I found out it was a bad ignition switch and ground wire so he put a new ignition switch and ground wire in and now my jeep runs good.Anthony knows what he doing and does it well,he will be getting all my mechanical work from now on.Thank you Anthony great job.

reviews.author: Kevin Nash
reviews.text: Fast, professional repair at a very reasonable rate. I will definitely bring my vehicles back again. Thank you!

reviews.author: Melvin Brisbone
reviews.text: Needed to get my 1991 F 150 up and running. AMH took the time evaluate the issues and provided solid results

reviews.author: Michael Dooley
reviews.text: Very professional and knowledgeable about what I needed. Definitely will be using them again for anymore automotive needs I may need

reviews.author: Asante Maceia (OG Grandpop)
reviews.text: My Alternator and starter both went bad, and both were fixed fast. And at a reasonable price for both.

reviews.author: Sonny Holden
reviews.text: GREAT customer service and availability. Prices are mind blowing and I'm definitely going to spread the word.
